message.reasoning_content: License income 20-60 alashi, bank ~30 alashi. Cash is king though; bid moderate. Rival 1 has 36 alashi cash. Bidding high enough to beat 36 is expensive; my cash only 23. But bids hidden; tie_order favors 1 anyway. License expected value ~40 alashi payout extra minus bid; profit if bid < income (~20-60). A bid of ~15-20 could win if others bid low, but opponent 1 with 36 cash could outbid. Expected: bid ~12? If I bid 12 and win at 12, EV = 40-12 = +28 alashi — huge. Worth it. Risk of losing: bid returned. So bidding is nearly free option except I might overpay relative to others' lower bids. Bid 10 alashi.
